rows.meaning: person harmed by crime or event
rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for a person harmed by a crime, event, or other wrongdoing.

example.english: I was a victim of this accident.
example.traditional: 我係呢單意外嘅受害人。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai6 ni1 daan1 ji3 ngoi6 ge3 sau6 hoi6 jan4

rows.meaning: person harmed by crime or event
rows.note: Use this mainly for the victim of a crime or wrongdoing, especially when referring to the aggrieved party in a complaint or case.

example.english: The victim has already reported it to the police and will give a formal statement.
example.traditional: 苦主已經去報警，仲要正式落口供。
example.jyutping: fu2 zyu2 ji5 ging1 heoi3 bou3 ging2 zung6 jiu3 zing3 sik1 lok6 hau2 gung3
